purpose: Create a Docker network. Default driver is `bridge`. For multi-host: `--driver overlay` (Swarm required). Driver-specific options via `--opt key=val` (repeatable).

flags.name: -d, --driver
flags.doc: Network driver: bridge|host|overlay|ipvlan|macvlan|none|<plugin>. Default `bridge`.

flags.name: --subnet
flags.doc: IPv4 or IPv6 subnet (repeatable, max one of each family per network).

flags.name: --ip-range
flags.doc: Sub-range of --subnet from which to auto-assign container IPs.

flags.name: --gateway
flags.doc: Gateway IP (default: first usable in subnet).

flags.name: --aux-address
flags.doc: Reserve specific IPs (won't be auto-assigned). Repeatable.

flags.name: --ipv6
flags.doc: Enable IPv6 on this network.

flags.name: --ipv4
flags.doc: Enable/disable IPv4 (default true). Set false for IPv6-only network.

flags.name: --ipam-driver
flags.doc: IP-address-management driver (default `default`).

flags.name: --ipam-opt
flags.doc: IPAM driver-specific option. Repeatable.

flags.name: -o, --opt
flags.doc: Driver-specific option. Repeatable. e.g. `-o com.docker.network.bridge.name=mybr0` for bridge driver.

flags.name: --scope
flags.doc: Control network scope (default per-driver: bridge=local, overlay=swarm).

flags.name: --attachable
flags.doc: Allow standalone containers to attach (overlay-specific). Without this, only Swarm services can attach.

flags.name: --internal
flags.doc: Restrict external access — no NAT/MASQUERADE; isolated cluster-internal network.

flags.name: --ingress
flags.doc: Create the swarm routing-mesh ingress network.

flags.name: --config-from
flags.doc: Copy IPAM/options from this config-only network.

flags.name: --config-only
flags.doc: Create a config-only network (template; not directly usable).

flags.name: --label
flags.doc: Set metadata. Repeatable.
